senses.gloss: अप्सु, for words beginning thus. See अप्सु-.

अप्सु 1. अ-प्सु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. without food;
not beautiful (?).

अप्सु 2. अप्सु (loc. pl. of अप्, q. v.), in the
water or waters. This word forms the first member
of various compounds, thus:
—अप्सु-क्षित्, त्, m.,
Ved. dwelling within the clouds, in the region be-
tween heaven and earth.
—अप्सु-चरु, अस्, ई, अम्,
Ved. going in the waters.
—अप्सु-ज, अस्, आ, अम्,
or अप्सु-जा, आस्, आस्, m. f., Ved. born in the waters.
—अप्सु-जित्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. vanquishing between the
waters or in the region of the clouds.
—अप्सु-मत्,
आन्, अती, अत्, possessed of what is in the waters; mot
losing one's nature in the water (e. g. the lightning
does not lose his fiery nature in the clouds); con-
taining the word अप्सु.
—अप्सु-योग, अस्, m. the
connecting power in water.
—अप्सु-योनि, इस्, m.,
Ved. born from the waters.
—अप्सु-वाह्, ट्, m., Ved.
driving in water.
—अप्सु-षद्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. dwelling
in the waters.
—अप्सु-सोम, अस्, m. Soma in water;
a cup filled with water.
—अप्सु-संशित, अस्, आ, अम्,
Ved. raised or excited in the waters.

अप्स 1. अप्-स, अस्, m., Ved. giving or
yielding (अप्) water [cf. अप्-सा below].
अप्स 2. अ-प्स, अस्, m., Ved. not destroying.

अप्सा अप्-सा, आस्, m. (fr. अप् and rt. सन्), Ved.
giving water.

अप्सर अप्-सर, अस्, m. water-goer, any
aquatic animal (see etym. of next).

अप्सरस् अप्सरस्, आस्, or अप्सरा, f. (fr. अप्,
q. v., and rt. सृ, ‘going in the waters or between
the waters of the clouds’); certain female divinities,
who reside in the sky and are the wives of the Gan-
dharvas; they have the faculty of changing their
shapes, are very fond of bathing, and are said to have
been produced at the churning of the ocean.
—अप्स-
रः-पति, इस्, m. Indra, lord of the Apsarasas.
—अप्स-
रस्-तीर्थ, अम्, n. a pool in which the Apsarasas
bathe.
—अप्सरा-पति, इस्, m. lord of the Apsarasas;
N. of the Gandharva Śikhaṇḍin.

अप्सराय, nom. A. अप्सरायते, -यितुम्, to behave
like an Apsaras.

अप्सव अप्सव, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. (if from
अप्सस्) possessed of form or shape; (if from अप्)
giving water.

आप्सव आप्सव, अस्, m. (fr. अप्सु, loc. pl. of
अप्), epithet of a Manu.

अप्सव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, fit for water, being in the
water.

अप्सस् अप्सस्, अस्, n. (fr. obs. rt. अप्), Ved.
cheek; shape, beauty (?).
आप्सरस, अस्, ई, अम्, coming from an Apsaras.
